renames.evidence: The instance stores points/text, origin coordinates, progress and chain multiplier. ug initializes it, bd interpolates its display, cf credits completed points and wa collects unfinished points. Unrelated static helpers retain their own identities.
Contact and drawing routines iterate this queue; detachment moves its members back to moving entities.
Attachment/contact changes and a match cooldown reaching zero set this flag; the session snapshots it before motion and the contact routines consume it.
Attached entities stamp entityId+1 into this raster; contact detection and boundary testing inspect it.
ul increments this when a collected triple shares spriteVariantIndex, before cooldown eligibility or deduplication is checked.
hd.f increments this release counter and compares it with sa.field_b before ld.b advances difficulty.
ul increments this when a collected triple shares entityCategoryKey, before cooldown eligibility or deduplication is checked.
The detach path sets this; session update resets it and excludes the board-clear bonus while it is true.
qe.a calculates this theme release threshold; hd.f compares it with ul.field_b, and the HUD displays the difference.
ec increments this per eligible scored triple and uses it as the points multiplier; scene/result setup resets it.
kc.b(int) sets this after rebuilding a dirty contact graph; gh consumes it for the board-clear check and clears it each tick.
Tutorial entry, progression and failure set this; accepting the prompt clears it. Normal motion, release and fast-fall paths are gated while it is set.
Chooses which of internal keys 96 and 97 applies each rotation direction; the input handler toggles it.
gh.render clears this after redrawing the attached board raster; contacts, transitions and ending ticks request that redraw.
Pointer spawning passes this as nb.a parameter 2, which becomes the motion initializer category argument and entityCategoryKey.
leaveTutorial and result completion set this; settled queues allow gh.b(byte) to run, and completion at tick 160 clears it. sk skips boundary checking while it is set.
Score/action submission checks this flag. Debug input and emitPointsPopup with the submission-blocking argument set it.
lc skips transfer from the spawn queue into moving entities while this is set. Debug input toggles it; tutorial/end paths also set it.
Passed as nb.a parameter 5: true chooses special kinds 1/2/3/4 from category/variant; false selects ordinary kind zero.
Result initialization records a.field_d.isEmpty here. The result message and extra 2000-point popup use that snapshot.
Debug input toggles this flag; rendering skips the entity layer and several overlays while it is set.
Set to 920 minus twice endingEntityRadius minus 59; result completion occurs when sceneAnimationTick equals this offset plus 150.
Captures ab.field_f before the entity-motion update; the later update branch uses it to request sk.a(int). This is a saved request, not a new geometry test.
Computed from no detachment this tick, an empty attached queue and a positive current-theme release count; the connectivity-rebuilt branch consumes it for a bonus.

gh update/render branch on phase 0 for play, 1 for the result sequence requested at the theme release threshold, 2/3/4 for result effects/countdown and 5 for result completion. Numeric IDs remain unchanged.
Result initialization computes the square root of the largest nontransparent sprite-pixel distance from the board center, or defaults to 29 without an ending entity.
Internal input key 16 sets this request; tutorial phase one consumes it to move to phase two.
ra.a records previously unset action bits and increments this count; menu/result branches use whether it is positive.
At scene-transition start false selects resetScoreState while true selects prepareNextTheme. leaveTutorial sets false; transition completion sets true. This flag also gates the progress HUD.
Render displays the ec and difficulty counters when set; debug input enables this flag.
gh.b(byte) sets this at transition tick zero and clears it at tick 160; render checks it during the transition.
Debug input toggles this; the pointer input handler calls nb.a only when it is set.
Receives ec.b(int), which returns true for a consumed nonempty match batch even when cooldowns prevent points from being awarded.
Result initialization adds 179; each shrinking-effect tick adds 7. Result render and the final popup display this separate bonus.
Pointer spawning passes this as nb.a parameter 4, which becomes the motion initializer variant argument and spriteVariantIndex.
The fog debug command toggles this; render draws a reduced overview circle with queue/entity markers.
gh.d(byte) sets this on the valid end path; update switches to the ending path and render omits the normal avatar.
ul fills the packed candidate array and increments this count; ec sorts and consumes that many candidates.
Avatar setup builds this mask; board initialization draws its white ownership marker before attached entity IDs.
ik/kc/bh set this when an entity or contact component detaches; entity reset clears it. Motion excludes detached entities from the attached count and accelerated-fall branch.
Kind 2 starts at 60; rh decrements once per attached update and marks contacts dirty at zero. ec requires all three candidate cooldowns to be nonpositive before awarding points.
ih.a finds the white 0xFFFFFF avatar marker in the ownership mask and sets this. kc uses it as a direct contact root; it does not describe transitive connectivity.
ld.b increments this index and reads the difficulty bit-flag table to adjust speed, rotation and entity selection parameters.
ab advances entities in this queue; contact handling transfers them to the attached queue.
ug inserts initialized ScorePopup objects here; cf advances them, bd renders them and wa drains unfinished points.
ug assigns awarded points; cf credits this amount at completion and wa sums it when draining unfinished popups.
ug assigns the chain argument; bd displays it with X when not one, and cf routes those points through addPopupPoints instead of addScore.
ug copies its Y argument here; bd interpolates from this coordinate toward y=34.
ug resets this to zero; cf advances it toward one; bd uses it to interpolate the popup toward the points panel.
ug sets Integer.toString(points); bd renders this stored string.
ug copies its X argument here; bd interpolates from this coordinate to the panel target.
ul packs three 10-bit entity IDs plus category/variant flag bits into each entry; ec sorts, deduplicates and decodes them.
Gameplay render caches the attached board scene in this raster and copies it during transitions.
Spawn motion initialization uses this magnitude to form entity velocity components; difficulty setup assigns it.
kc clears this array and marks entity IDs while traversing contact connectivity.
Entity initialization removes a free entity from this queue; completed entity animations return their objects here.
Gameplay applies this angular step with opposite signs for the two rotation controls; difficulty setup assigns it.
Contact link changes set this; kc rebuilds connectivity only when dirty and clears it afterward.
qe.a computes ceil(fa.field_b/3) here; hd.f compares it with di.field_g to advance difficulty after that many releases.
Ownership-mask contact decoding and packed match IDs index this array to resolve GameplayEntity objects.
ug takes a popup from this pool; cf returns completed popups using intrusive insertion.
hd.f increments this per release; the theme HUD subtracts it from fa.field_b; theme preparation resets it.
Entity sprite preparation and ending-radius scanning use this temporary raster.
The pixel contact probe uses this raster while resolving moving-entity contacts.
lc advances staged entities and releases ready members to ji.field_r.
Render iteration uses the popup and builds the X multiplier plus points text for chain multipliers other than one.

Advances moving-entity positions, computes motion relative to the rotated board and queues ownership-mask contact candidates.
Interpolates active popup position toward the points panel and renders either plain points or chain multiplier plus points.
Increases active popup progress; once it reaches one, credits points to score or the pending panel and returns the popup to the free pool.
Iterates the attached entity queue and draws its entity sprites.
Sorts/deduplicates packed triples, checks each entity cooldown, awards chain-scaled points and returns whether a nonempty batch was processed.
Draws the phase-2 expansion, phase-3 shrinking circle with bonus text and the later fading countdown.
Advances the scene animation to tick 160, prepares the next theme or resets score at tick zero, clears entity queues and commits transition flags at completion.
Draws the remaining release count in normal play and the phase-specific HUD text otherwise.
Initializes the ending sprite radius/bonus, advances expansion/shrink/countdown phases and emits the bonus popups at completion.
Resets the session phase/result fields, selects the next theme ID and requests its assets/music.
Draws attached entities whose sprite-kind ID is nonzero.
Increments theme/difficulty release counts and requests a theme transition or advances difficulty at their thresholds.
Returns true only when moving, spawn and transient animation queues are empty and the additional jl.field_t gate is clear. The attached queue may remain nonempty.
Probes mask coordinates, resolves encoded entity IDs and records avatar or entity contacts.
Links the entity pair and related-entity/category/variant counts while resolving the original special-kind contact rules.
Updates staged entities and transfers ready members to moving entities unless spawnReleaseDisabled is set.
Probes symmetric pixels around a radius-230 circle centered at (320,240) in the currently selected raster and returns on the first nonzero pixel.
Increments the difficulty step and loads its existing motion, angular-speed and release-threshold tables.
Initializes an entity at pointer coordinates with the supplied category/variant and optional special-kind selection.
Iterates the attached queue, decreases match cooldowns, updates the selected sprites, checks avatar-contact special effects and computes the maximum squared distance from the board center.
Checks the ownership raster boundary outside scene transitions; on loss starts the end sequence and traverses contacts from the farthest entity to assign staggered ending lifetimes.
Takes a popup from the pool, initializes its points, chain and origin, and inserts it into the active queue. If the pool is empty it credits points directly.
Collects triples of connected entities sharing variant or category, storing sorted entity IDs and equality flags in the packed candidate array.
Removes every active popup and returns the sum of its uncredited points without multiplying them again.
